title: appendSceneLog sequence computation is racy
description: Correctness review finding. packages/core/src/orchestrator/scene.ts computes seq via SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq),0)+1 then INSERT; concurrent writers can read the same MAX and the second INSERT fails the composite PRIMARY KEY. Single-threaded CLI today but runTurn is async. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Scene-log sequence is collision-free under concurrent appends or single-writer is enforced and documented.
close_reason: Fixed via PR #55: appendSceneLog now uses a single INSERT with a subquery for seq and RETURNING seq, so the MAX read and the row write happen under the same write lock. Existing scene-log tests cover monotonic sequencing.
